_snapshotData.name: Rockwell Automation, Inc.
_snapshotData.description: Rockwell Automation, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides industrial automation and digital transformation solutions in North America, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, the Asia Pacific, and Latin America. It operates in three segments: Intelligent Devices, Software & Control, and Lifecycle Services. The company offers drives, motion, material handling, safety, sensing, industrial components, hardware, software, and configured-to-order products; and control and visualization software and hardware, digital twin, simulation and information software, network and security infrastructure, and custom-engineered systems and software. It also provides digital consulting services; professional services, including engineered-to-order solutions; recurring services, such as cybersecurity, safety, asset management, and remote monitoring; customer technical support and repair services; optimization consulting services; and training services, as well as spare parts. The company sells its products through independent distributors in relation to its direct sales force. It serves discrete end markets, including automotive, semiconductor, e-commerce, and warehouse automation; hybrid end markets, such as food and beverage, household and personal care, and life sciences; and process end markets, including energy, mining, and chemicals. The company was formerly known as Rockwell International Corporation and changed its name to Rockwell Automation, Inc. in February 2002. Rockwell Automation, Inc. was incorporated in 1996 and is headquartered in Milwaukee, Wisconsin.
